set.body:
Scope: an approved-host private-data handoff using the existing STORYMODEL4S_DATA layout and tools, without a new service or dependency. Owner-approved first destination: buc-gw01 (Tailscale-reported macOS); tailnet presence alone is not approval. Future destinations require recorded owner approval for the relevant corpus/use. Code and synthetic development remain possible elsewhere.

Acceptance: a documented/tool-assisted dry-run selects the minimum corpus/model/study assets and checks an explicitly approved destination identity and storage root; authenticated encrypted transfer resumes without source deletion or blind destination replacement; a private manifest records relative asset identities, sizes/counts and SHA-256, corpus admission and held-out restrictions; destination verifies all bytes before promotion/admission and executes a reader smoke; source originals remain until verified readback. Private text, identifying filenames, row-level results and data-bearing logs stay in approved private storage, outside Git/CI/public artifacts. Committed receipts contain only reviewed content-free identities/status.

Synthetic witnesses: unapproved destination refuses before transfer; interrupted copying resumes idempotently; corrupted/truncated bytes fail admission; existing unrelated/conflicting destination assets survive; absent required assets produce explicit unavailable capabilities. Then record an actual approved buc-gw01 transfer and destination readback without exposing contents. Dataset permissions and sealed partitions travel unchanged; copying does not widen admission. Implementation and real transfer remain pending.

Current PLAN.md stage 1 and data/README.md govern the handoff. This is a non-blocking child of DELIVERY; private-data journeys wait for it, public/synthetic work can proceed.
set.title: Reliable private-data handoff between approved development hosts
